description: Poland UOKiK Abusive Clauses Registry Scraper. Rejestr klauzul niedozwolonych UOKiK - 7,500+ zakazanych postanowień umownych. Search court-banned contract clauses by defendant, industry, legal category. No API exists. Legal compliance, consumer protection. JSON. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

category.description: Filter by legal category of the clause violation. Leave empty for all categories.
category.title: Category (Zagadnienie)

defendant.description: Filter by defendant company name (partial match).
defendant.title: Defendant Name (Pozwany)

exportAll.description: Export all clauses from the registry (~7,500 entries). Ignores other filters.
exportAll.title: Export All

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results. Default: 100. Set to 0 for unlimited.
maxResults.title: Max Results

name: regdata_uokik_clauses
